literal_meaning: চর (জঙ্গম বা চলমান) এবং অচর (স্থাবর বা অচল)
figurative_meaning_en: Everything in creation, both movable and immovable things; the entire universe
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকৃতির চরাচর লীলায় মগ্ন হয়ে রইলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: His name has echoed throughout the charachara.
I was lost in the play of nature's charachara.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'charāchara', a philosophical term used in ancient Indian texts like the Vedas and Upanishads to denote all animate and inanimate entities in the cosmos.
note: Often used in poetic and religious contexts to evoke the totality of existence.
